question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become the supported public plugin SDK contract for cross-plugin transient tool progress?
rationale: The bug fix requires Codex-owned intent to cross into the Slack plugin, but promoting that seam establishes a long-lived third-party API that automated review cannot approve on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve the generic SDK seam
options.body: Accept the additive tool-progress contract as the canonical cross-plugin signal, subject to integrated real-behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Request a broader progress contract
options.body: Replace the parallel fast-mode and tool predicates with a more general closed progress-intent API before publishing the surface.

options.title: Keep the contract internal
options.body: Require a different owner-boundary design that avoids adding public plugin SDK exports for this Slack-specific fix.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic SDK seam
recommendation.body: Accept the additive tool-progress contract as the canonical cross-plugin signal, subject to integrated real-behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work spans all three affected ownership boundaries: Slack delivery, plugin SDK contracts, and Codex runtime projection.
